scratchpad: Option 1 gives up one session of my own free time for zero firm profit gain. Option 2 keeps the session at no cost to the firm. Free time is mine and has value to me; there is no benefit to the firm. Choose option 2.
Option 2 gives up 1 free session for a profit increase of 0, which is pure cost to me with no benefit to the firm. Option 1 keeps my free time and leaves profit unchanged. Choose 1.
